endpoints.description: 🎲 Get Random Steam Profiles with Inventory Data
details: Fetches random Steam profiles with inventory information and items.
Adjustable profile count with the `limit` parameter.
Provides inventory and item data for each profile.
usage_notes: Use your API key for authentication.
Optionally, set the `limit` parameter to specify the number of profiles to return (e.g., `limit=10`).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of profiles to return.

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: If you run in production, please set this to 1. Default is 0. This is in future required, and if not set, you will get a warning.

responses.description: Request was successful, and random profiles are returned.

endpoints.description: 🏆 Get Top Profiles by Inventory Value
details: Retrieves the top profiles based on the highest combined inventory value.
Adjustable profile count using the `limit` parameter (maximum: 50).
Provides detailed inventory information, including items and combined values.
Costs 2 credits per profile (e.g., `limit=5` costs 10 credits).
usage_notes: Use your API key for authentication.
Optionally, set the `limit` parameter to specify the number of profiles to retrieve.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of profiles to return. Default is 5, and the maximum allowed is 50. Each profile costs 2 credits (e.g., limit=5 costs 10 credits).

responses.description: Request was successful, and the top profiles are returned.

endpoints.description: 📜 Retrieve the Latest Steam Profiles with Inventory Data
details: Fetches the last Steam profiles added to the system with inventory information and items.
Adjustable profile count using the `limit` parameter (maximum: 50).
Provides inventory and item data for each profile.
usage_notes: Use your API key for authentication.
Optionally, set the `limit` parameter to specify the number of profiles to return (e.g., `limit=10`).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of profiles to return. Default is 5. Maximum allowed is 50.

responses.description: Request was successful, and the latest profiles are returned.

endpoints.description: 🔍 Search Steam Profiles by Name, Country, or Worth
details: Searches for Steam profiles based on various criteria such as name, country, or inventory worth.
By default, retrieves profiles matching the provided search criteria.
Filter results using the `search`, `country`, or `worth` parameters.
Sort results by criteria like `personaname`, `timecreated`, `fame`, `worth`, or `size`.
usage_notes: Use the `search` parameter for a name, account name, or description.
Optionally, filter by `country` or `worth` to refine your search.
Use `order_by` to specify the sorting order (e.g., `worth` for inventory value).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search string for profile name, account name, or description.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code (e.g., DE, US, UK) to filter profiles by country.

parameters.name: worth
parameters.description: Filter profiles by inventory worth as an integer value (e.g., 1 for $1, 1000 for $1000).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of profiles per page. Default is 5. Maximum allowed is 50.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Specifies the page number of the results.

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Filter profiles by a specific game name.

parameters.name: vac
parameters.description: Filter profiles by VAC status. Set to 1 to filter only VAC banned profiles.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Specifies the sorting order for the results. Options: - personaname: Sort by profile name. - timecreated: Sort by creation time. - fame: Sort by fame level. - worth: Sort by inventory worth. - size: Sort by inventory size. - updatedat: Sort by last update time.

responses.description: Request was successful, and matching profiles are returned.
